# Crossplane XRD + Composition (functions mode)

Layout:

```
crossplane/
├── functions.yaml                 # function-patch-and-transform install
├── providers.yaml                 # provider-aws-* + ProviderConfigs (dev/prod)
├── apis/
│   ├── xrd.yaml                   # CompositeResourceDefinition
│   └── composition.yaml           # Composition (mode: Pipeline)
├── claims/
│   ├── dev.yaml
│   └── prod.yaml
└── secrets/
    └── README.md                  # SOPS / ExternalSecret for the DB master password
```

## `crossplane/apis/composition.yaml`

```yaml
apiVersion: apiextensions.crossplane.io/v1
kind: Composition
metadata:
  name: appinfra-aws
spec:
  compositeTypeRef:
    apiVersion: platform.example.com/v1alpha1
    kind: XAppInfra
  writeConnectionSecretsToNamespace: crossplane-system
  mode: Pipeline
  pipeline:
    - step: patch-and-transform
      functionRef:
        name: function-patch-and-transform
      input:
        apiVersion: pt.fn.crossplane.io/v1beta1
        kind: Resources
        patchSets:
          - name: common
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.region
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.region
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.labels[app.kubernetes.io/environment]

        resources:
          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          # 1. S3 bucket (+ versioning, SSE, full public-access block)
          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: bucket
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Bucket
              spec:
                forProvider: {}
                deletionPolicy: Orphan
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucket.name
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                toFieldPath: status.bucketName
            connectionDetails:
              - name: bucket
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]

          - name: bucket-versioning
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketVersioning
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  versioningConfiguration:
                    - status: Enabled
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common

          - name: bucket-encryption
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketServerSideEncryptionConfiguration
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
                  rule:
                    - bucketKeyEnabled: true
                      applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        - sseAlgorithm: AES256
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common
              # If a KMS key is supplied (prod), switch to SSE-KMS.
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucket.kmsKeyArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.rule[0].applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault[0].kmsMasterKeyId
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucket.kmsKeyArn
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.rule[0].applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault[0].sseAlgorithm
                policy:
                  fromFieldPath: Optional
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Convert
                      convert: ToUpper
                  - type: map
                    map: {}
                    # any non-empty kmsKeyArn -> aws:kms
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Format
                      fmt: "aws:kms"

          - name: bucket-public-access-block
            base:
              apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: BucketPublicAccessBlock
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  blockPublicAcls: true
                  blockPublicPolicy: true
                  ignorePublicAcls: true
                  restrictPublicBuckets: true
                  bucketSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common

          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          # 2. RDS PostgreSQL
          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: rds
            base:
              apiVersion: rds.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Instance
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  engine: postgres
                  engineVersion: "16.3"
                  username: appadmin
                  dbName: app
                  storageType: gp3
                  autoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
                  # --- acceptance criteria ---
                  deletionProtection: true
                  publiclyAccessible: false
                  backupRetentionPeriod: 7
                  storageEncrypted: true
                  skipFinalSnapshot: false
                  copyTagsToSnapshot: true
                  performanceInsightsEnabled: true
                  enabledCloudwatchLogsExports: [postgresql, upgrade]
                deletionPolicy: Orphan
                writeConnectionSecretToRef:
                  namespace: crossplane-system
            patches:
              - type: PatchSet
                patchSetName: common
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.instanceClass
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.instanceClass
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.allocatedStorage
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.allocatedStorage
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.multiAZ
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.multiAz
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.storageEncrypted
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.storageEncrypted
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.backupRetentionPeriod
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.backupRetentionPeriod
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.dbSubnetGroupName
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbSubnetGroupName
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.vpcSecurityGroupIds
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.vpcSecurityGroupIds
              # Master password never lives in Git: read from a K8s Secret
              # produced by SOPS (knr-ops) or External Secrets Operator.
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.masterPasswordSecretRef.name
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.masterPasswordSecretRef.namespace
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.namespace
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.database.masterPasswordSecretRef.key
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef.key
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: metadata.uid
                toFieldPath: spec.writeConnectionSecretToRef.name
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Format
                      fmt: "%s-rds"
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Format
                      fmt: "app-%s-postgres"
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
                toFieldPath: status.dbEndpoint
            connectionDetails:
              - name: endpoint
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.address
              - name: port
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.port
              - name: database
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.forProvider.dbName
              - name: username
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.forProvider.username
              - name: password
                type: FromConnectionSecretKey
                fromConnectionSecretKey: attribute.password

          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          # 3. IAM role for service accounts (IRSA) + least-privilege policy
          # ------------------------------------------------------------------
          - name: irsa-role
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: Role
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  maxSessionDuration: 3600
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Format
                      fmt: "app-%s-irsa"
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.assumeRolePolicy
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.oidcProviderArn
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.oidcIssuerHost
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.oidcIssuerHost
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.namespace
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.irsa.serviceAccount
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow",
                      "Principal":{"Federated":"%s"},
                      "Action":"sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
                      "Condition":{"StringEquals":{
                      "%s:aud":"sts.amazonaws.com",
                      "%s:sub":"system:serviceaccount:%s:%s"}}}]}
              - type: ToCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn
                toFieldPath: status.roleArn
            connectionDetails:
              - name: roleArn
                type: FromFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: status.atProvider.arn

          - name: irsa-role-policy
            base:
              apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
              kind: RolePolicy
              spec:
                forProvider:
                  roleSelector:
                    matchControllerRef: true
            patches:
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.providerConfigName
                toFieldPath: spec.providerConfigRef.name
              - type: FromCompositeFieldPath
                fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.environment
                toFieldPath: metadata.annotations[crossplane.io/external-name]
                transforms:
                  - type: string
                    string:
                      type: Format
                      fmt: "app-%s-bucket-access"
              # Least privilege: explicit actions, scoped to this bucket only.
              - type: CombineFromComposite
                toFieldPath: spec.forProvider.policy
                combine:
                  variables:
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucket.name
                    - fromFieldPath: spec.parameters.bucket.name
                  strategy: string
                  string:
                    fmt: >-
                      {"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[
                      {"Sid":"ListOwnBucket","Effect":"Allow",
                      "Action":["s3:ListBucket","s3:GetBucketLocation"],
                      "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s"},
                      {"Sid":"ObjectRW","Effect":"Allow",
                      "Action":["s3:GetObject","s3:GetObjectVersion","s3:PutObject","s3:DeleteObject"],
                      "Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::%s/*"}]}
```

> Note on the `bucket-encryption` KMS patch: the `Optional` policy means the two
> KMS patches are skipped entirely when `spec.parameters.bucket.kmsKeyArn` is
> unset (dev), leaving the `AES256` base value. When set (prod), the algorithm
> becomes `aws:kms` with the supplied key.

## `crossplane/secrets/README.md`

```md
# DB master password

Never committed in plaintext. Two supported paths:

1. SOPS (knr-ops style) — `secrets/app-<env>-db-master.sops.yaml`, age-encrypted,
   decrypted by ksops/Flux into `crossplane-system/app-<env>-db-master`.
2. External Secrets Operator — `ExternalSecret` sourcing AWS Secrets Manager,
   materialising the same Secret name/key.

The Composition only ever references it via
`spec.forProvider.passwordSecretRef`, so the value never enters the XR/claim.

The generated connection Secret (`app-<env>-conn`, keys: endpoint/port/
username/password/database/bucket/roleArn) is written by Crossplane at runtime
and is not part of the Git tree.
```

## Acceptance criteria mapping

| Criterion | Where |
|---|---|
| Bucket versioning + SSE + no public access | `bucket-versioning`, `bucket-encryption` (AES256 / SSE-KMS in prod), `bucket-public-access-block` (all four flags true) |
| RDS deletion protection, backups ≥ 7d, not public | `rds` base: `deletionProtection: true`, `backupRetentionPeriod: 7` (schema `minimum: 7`, prod 30), `publiclyAccessible: false`, `skipFinalSnapshot: false` |
| Secret never plaintext in Git | `passwordSecretRef` → SOPS/ESO-managed Secret; connection details emitted at runtime only |
| IAM least privilege | IRSA trust scoped to exact `namespace:serviceaccount`; `RolePolicy` enumerates actions and scopes ARNs to the single bucket — no `*` actions |
| Environment isolation | Separate claims, namespaces, ProviderConfigs (`aws-dev`/`aws-prod`), regions, accounts; each XR reconciles independently |
| Functions mode | `mode: Pipeline` + `function-patch-and-transform` |
